blocks.text: Python mein if-else ko chhota kar ke ek hi line mein bhi likha ja sakta hai. Isay short hand if-else kehte hain.

#          Syntax of short hand if-else statement
action_if_true if condition else action_if_false

temperature = 15
print("It’s a hot day") if temperature > 30 else print("It’s not a hot day")

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab short hand statement ko teen lines mein tor kar chhapti hai; aise SyntaxError aata hai. Short hand if-else poori ek line mein likha jata hai, jaise oopar hai.

Wazahat: yeh pichhle topic wali misaal hi hai, bas chhoti shakal mein. Output variable temperature ki value par depend karta hai (us par tikka hai): 30 se zyada ho to "It's a hot day", warna "It's not a hot day". Yahan 15 hai, to "It's not a hot day" aata hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Ek if-else statement aur ek short hand if-else statement likhein jo check kare ke number even (juft) hai ya odd (taaq), aur sahi message print kare.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: short hand if-else se even/odd kaise likhenge?
blocks.explanation: num = 7; print("Even") if num % 2 == 0 else print("Odd"). 7 % 2 = 1 hai, to "Odd" print hota hai. Aam if-else wala jawab pichhle topic (2.4.1.2) ke self-check mein hai.

blocks.prompt: Short-hand if-else aam if-else se kaise alag hai (short question 4)?
blocks.explanation: Short hand poora faisla ek line mein likhta hai aur har case ke liye sirf ek value ya ek kaam deta hai, is liye yeh chhote aur seedhe faislon ke liye theek hai. Aam if-else alag indented blocks istemal karta hai aur har branch (raaste) mein kai statements rakh sakta hai.

items: Short hand: kaam_agar_True if condition else kaam_agar_False, sab ek line mein.
